evals.name: stuck
evals.prompt: My parser gives 9 for `1 + 2 * 3` instead of 7. I parse left to right: parse a number, then while next is an operator, combine. How do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint rather than rewriting the whole parser; Explains operator precedence and fixes it via precedence climbing/Pratt parsing or separate grammar levels (term/factor)
